question.text: A heat engine absorbs heat $Q_1$ at temperature $T_1$ and heat $Q_2$ at temperature $T_2$. Work done by the engine is $J\left(Q_1+Q_2\right)$. This data

options.text: violates $1^{\text {st }}$ law of thermodynamics if $Q_1$ is $-v e$
violates $1^{\text {st }}$ law of thermodynamics if $Q_2$ is $-$ ve
does not violate $1^{\text {st }}$ law of thermodynamics

solution.text: Some mechanical energy is always converted (lost) to other forms of energy.
